about: B55 PR A0 synthetic axis SETs (docs/b55/BREAKOUT_SEQUENCE_SPEC.md 3.7). Not pool files. Each is a complete SET at the schema's defaults plus base and lines; base is a breakout sequence as section 7 lists it for the templates (the grid engine, the switch, both delays 0, no delayed lots, RSI off, an explicit ATR_TF_). probes: the SET's values (current), then each Y axis at its start and stop with the others at their values; ladder: every rung (controller only). A0 ships the switch refused, so a probe inside every rule ends at BRK_SEQ_NOT_BUILT; PR A's commit that adds the start path turns those into ok. Read by controller/test_b55_init.py and scripts/test_b55_init.cjs.

alerts.BRK_WITHOUT_SINGLE: Initialization Failed: BRK_Mode needs the single-trade engine (Engine_Mode=Engine_Single).
alerts.BRK_SEQ_WITHOUT_BRK: Initialization Failed: BRK_Start_Seq needs a breakout mode (BRK_Mode=BRK_NBar or BRK_PriorDay).
alerts.BRK_SEQ_WITH_SINGLE: Initialization Failed: BRK_Start_Seq needs the grid engine (Engine_Mode=Engine_Grid).
alerts.BRK_SEQ_WITH_DELAY: Initialization Failed: BRK_Start_Seq needs Delay_Trade=0 and Delay_Trade_Live=0 (the break opens the sequence's first position).
alerts.BRK_SEQ_NOT_BUILT: Initialization Failed: BRK_Start_Seq=true is not built in this build yet (it has no sequence start path).

sets.about: N-bar sequence, four BRK axes at Y inside their bounds: every probe passes every rule and ends at the not-built refusal (A0)
Prior-day sequence on an H1 trigger, the buffer, the latch and Reverse_Seq at Y: every probe ends at the not-built refusal (A0)
N-bar sequence with Delay_Trade=1 (a virtual start): refused at every probe
N-bar sequence, Delay_Trade_Live 0..1 at Y: 0 passes the delay rule (and ends at the not-built refusal, A0), 1 is refused, so the ladder is refused
The switch without a breakout mode: refused at every probe (BRK_Bars is never read)
The switch on a valid breakout single (Engine_Single, Single_SL_ATR 1.0): refused at every probe
B54's refusal, kept: a breakout on the grid engine with the switch off is refused at every probe by line 5128, with B54's alert
The switch off reads no delay: a grid sequence with no breakout and Delay_Trade 0..2 at Y passes at every probe
